lawful_good.name: Lawful Good
lawful_good.description: Combines honor and compassion, acting with tradition and moral integrity to protect others.

neutral_good.name: Neutral Good
neutral_good.description: Guided by conscience to do the right thing, helping others regardless of rules or authority.

chaotic_good.name: Chaotic Good
chaotic_good.description: Follows a personal moral compass toward freedom and kindness, rebelling against tyranny.

lawful_neutral.name: Lawful Neutral
lawful_neutral.description: Acts according to law, order, custom, or personal codes without bias toward good or evil.

true_neutral.name: True Neutral
true_neutral.description: Prefers balance over dogma, avoiding strong commitments to law, chaos, good, or evil.

chaotic_neutral.name: Chaotic Neutral
chaotic_neutral.description: Values absolute personal freedom above all else, following whim without malice or altruism.

lawful_evil.name: Lawful Evil
lawful_evil.description: Methodically uses laws, order, or authority to manipulate systems and advance selfish goals.

neutral_evil.name: Neutral Evil
neutral_evil.description: Purely self-serving, doing whatever it takes to gain power without honor or senseless mayhem.

chaotic_evil.name: Chaotic Evil
chaotic_evil.description: Driven by wild desires and destruction, showing total disregard for order, life, or rules.
